title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account, workspace, and integrations

profile.title: Profile Information
profile.subtitle: Update your name and profile photo.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your account password and security settings.
security.social_login_desc: Your account is linked to Google. Password login is not available.
security.password_login_desc: You can change your password below.
security.google_managed_notice: Password management is handled by Google. To change your password, visit your Google account settings.

errors.too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.

mfa.title: Two-factor auth (TOTP)
mfa.description: Add a second factor — a 6-digit code from your authenticator app — on top of your password. Strongly recommended for admin accounts.
mfa.enrol_desc: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or any TOTP app.
mfa.backup_title: Save these backup codes — shown once
mfa.backup_desc: Each code can be used ONCE if you lose your authenticator. Store them in a password manager.
mfa.prompt_regenerate: Enter your current 6-digit code to regenerate backup codes:
mfa.disable_modal_desc: We require your password AND a current 6-digit code so a hijacker can't disable MFA from a stolen session.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.empty_desc: Your active sessions will appear here.
sessions.confirm_revoke: Revoke this session? The device will be signed out immediately.
sessions.confirm_sign_out_all: Sign out of every other device? This cannot be undone.

agency.title: Agency Connection
agency.subtitle: Manage your connection to your agency on Bop Social.
agency.no_agency_desc: You are not currently connected to any agency.

perms.posts: Create and schedule posts on your behalf
perms.ai_insights: Generate AI insights for your account

agency.confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to disconnect from {{name}}? They will lose access to your account and be notified by email.
agency.error: Failed to disconnect. Please try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose which events you'd like to be notified about, and where.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Customise how Bop Social looks and feels.
appearance.theme_desc: Choose a light or dark theme. "System" matches your OS preference.
appearance.density_desc: Show more or less content per screen. "Compact" reduces row heights and padding.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Speed up your workflow with these keyboard shortcuts.
shortcuts.hint: Custom keybindings coming soon. Press {{key}} from anywhere to view this list.

api_keys.title: API Keys
api_keys.subtitle: Programmatic access for your scripts and integrations. Keys are stored as SHA-256 hashes — we never see the plaintext after creation.
api_keys.hint: Keys are shown once at generation — copy and store them securely.
api_keys.warning_title: Save this key now — it will not be shown again
api_keys.empty_desc: Generate your first key above to start integrating Bop Social with your other tools.
api_keys.err_name_required: Give the key a name first
api_keys.confirm_revoke: Revoke this key? Any application using it will stop working.

data_privacy.title: Data & Privacy
data_privacy.subtitle: Your data, your rights. Export everything, manage consents, pause processing, or delete your account.
data_privacy.export_desc: Download a ZIP with your profile, owned workspaces, consent log, and request history. Delivered via email link (expires in 7 days).
data_privacy.consents_desc: Toggle communication and tracking preferences. Withdrawals take effect immediately.
data_privacy.pause_desc: When paused, sync tasks skip your workspaces, AI features are disabled, and the composer goes read-only. You can still log in to view existing data.
data_privacy.delete_account_desc: Permanently delete your account, sessions, MFA, API keys, and personal data after a 30-day grace period. Audit logs are anonymised but retained for compliance.
data_privacy.export_queued: Export queued — we will email you when it is ready
data_privacy.prompt_delete_reason: Tell us why (optional). Your account will be permanently deleted in 30 days unless canceled.
data_privacy.deletion_scheduled_toast: Deletion scheduled — you have 30 days to cancel

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Receive HTTP POST notifications when events happen in your workspace.
webhooks.empty_desc: Add an HTTPS endpoint above to start receiving events.

more.title: More settings
more.subtitle: Some areas live as their own pages. Jump to them here.

team.label: Team & permissions
team.desc: Invite teammates, assign roles, override permissions.

workspaces.label: Workspaces (clients)
workspaces.desc: Manage every client account in your agency.

audit_log.label: Audit log
audit_log.desc: Search every action across your account.

danger_zone.title: Danger Zone
danger_zone.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
danger_zone.reason_title: Why are you deleting your account?
danger_zone.reason_desc: Please select a reason. This helps us improve Bop Social.

reasons.no_longer_need: I no longer need this account

warnings.analytics: All your analytics data and reports

danger_zone.error: Failed to delete account. Please try again.
